Marissa — thanks. Based on the volumes and SLOs here are three ballpark options we can present. Assumptions: model is a large open decoder (similar to Llama-variants) with 8k context usage for many queries; typical utilization expected ~60-80% on reserved fleet. All numbers are rough estimates — final pricing depends on model choice, quantization, and acceptance of burst policies.

Option A — Pilot (lower commitment)\- GPU: 1x NVIDIA H100 80GB reserved\- Throughput: supports ~25-40M tokens/month with headroom for spikes (fits pilot 20-30M)\- List price (no term discount): $16,000 / month\- Estimated unit economics: ~$550 / 1M tokens at 30M usage (note: unit $ falls as usage rises)

Option B — Medium (recommended for ramp to 100M)\- GPU: 2x NVIDIA H100 80GB reserved (balanced across two nodes)\- Throughput: comfortably supports ~80-130M tokens/month depending on batching and model profile\- List price: $28,500 / month\- Estimated unit economics: ~$285 / 1M tokens at 100M usage

Option C — Large / Committed (best $/token)\- GPU: 4x NVIDIA H100 80GB reserved (sharded across 2+ pods)\- Throughput: 250-350M tokens/month with room for growth and redundant capacity for maintenance windows\- List price: $48,000 / month\- Estimated unit economics: ~$140 / 1M tokens at 300M usage

Discounting notes:
- 12-month committed term: additional 10-18% off list depending on size.
- We can provide short-term commit + 3-mo ramp terms for pilots to reduce initial sticker shock.
- If FinLytics chooses A100 vs H100 we can model a ~10-20% lower list price but expect ~15-30% lower throughput for the same model/config.

Operational notes:
- Private/dedicated deployment includes KMS integration and audit logs (add-on pricing applies for on-prem packaging).
- For their p95 latency target we recommend 2xH100 for production (Option B) to avoid contention and provide failover.

If you want, I can draft a concise pricing summary (table) to send to Sarah.

— Marcus
